codex_update_eureka_enhancements.title: Developer Mode bounded diagnostics
codex_update_eureka_enhancements.action: Use CDP and DOM snapshots for marker checks, performance diagnostics, console/network/runtime state, never broad transcript scraping.

codex_update_eureka_enhancements.title: Browser retry classifier
codex_update_eureka_enhancements.action: Classify Browser states as send-timeout, stopped-thinking, marker-missing, marker-present, or route-blocked.

codex_update_eureka_enhancements.title: Goal-preservation continuity
codex_update_eureka_enhancements.action: Use CLI 0.140 goal preservation for large phase prompts and image attachments through hashes plus continuity pointers.

codex_update_eureka_enhancements.title: Usage watch ledger
codex_update_eureka_enhancements.action: Use usage signals as optional budget receipts, not phase-completion claims.

codex_update_eureka_enhancements.title: Session deletion denylist
codex_update_eureka_enhancements.action: Keep codex delete, /delete, and app-server thread/delete approval-gated and absent from automated runners.

codex_update_eureka_enhancements.title: Import-flow quarantine
codex_update_eureka_enhancements.action: Treat /import from external agents as a separately approved migration workflow with pre/post receipts.

codex_update_eureka_enhancements.title: Unified mentions prompt hygiene
codex_update_eureka_enhancements.action: Update sibling prompts to prefer explicit file references and omega-mini lookup files through mentions when safely exposed.

codex_update_eureka_enhancements.title: MCP startup retry integration
codex_update_eureka_enhancements.action: Fold transient MCP retry behavior into stale-flow refresh before escalating connector blockers.

codex_update_eureka_enhancements.title: Large-repo exact lookup discipline
codex_update_eureka_enhancements.action: Use faster archive lookup and diff rendering to support exact file lists, not broad branch rummaging.

codex_update_eureka_enhancements.title: D-drive storage invariant
codex_update_eureka_enhancements.action: Keep heavy temp, receipt, and runner workloads on D or temp-only safe folders while monitoring C free space.

codex_update_eureka_enhancements.title: Remote plugin auth guard
codex_update_eureka_enhancements.action: Treat app/plugin auth requirements as read-only status unless user separately approves install/account changes.

codex_update_eureka_enhancements.title: Background output interrupt receipt
codex_update_eureka_enhancements.action: For non-TTY background commands, preserve final output/status in temp-only logs and publish status receipts only.
